item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po yang rtse klong chen gyi khrid rim bye brag gi sdeb bshad
item.coloph: ces pas rdzogs pa chen po yang rtse klong chen gyi phyi nang gsang gsum 'am (mam) rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi khrid rim sdebs (sdeb) bshad 'di ni gangs can khrod 'dir mkhas cing grags pa skyabs kyi ston pa rin chen 'od zer gyi dbon po rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/ gzhung lugs 'di la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i phrug tshang bya bral drung mu wer zhi yis/ mdo smad tha'u ja dbus kyi sa char bsdebs pas dge legs 'phel//
